entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Hmph, serves them right.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Are you sure that was what you wanted?
entries.uk: Ти певен, що хотів саме цього?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Of course it was!

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: You made me look everywhere for you...

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: What were you doing somewhere[n]without any reception? Out late with[n]guys— That's it, isn't it?
entries.uk: Що ти робила там, де немає зв'язку?[n]Гуляла допізна з хлопцями?[n]Так, я вгадав?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I would never do such a thing!
entries.uk: Я б ніколи такого не зробила!

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: C'mon, let me have some fun too,[n]will ya?
entries.uk: Та ну, дай і мені трохи розважитися,[n]га?

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: Can't you do that for me?
entries.uk: Невже ти не можеш зробити це[n]для мене?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Ow!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Haru!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You little— Let go of Haru!

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: What the— Goddamn cat!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Mona-chan!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Dammit... I AM useless...!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Someone... Anyone... Is anybody[n]out there!?

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: Will you shut up, you stupid cat!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Damn that Morgana... He is so getting it[n]the next time we run into him.
entries.uk: Клятий Моргана... Ох і дістанеться йому,[n]коли ми його знову зустрінемо.

entries.speaker: Morgana's Voice
entries.en: Some...body?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Was that... Mona's voice!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, over there! That doesn't seem right[n]to me!
entries.uk: Гей, он там! Щось мені це[n]не подобається!

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Please... Let go!

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Okumura-san!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Mona!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: The hell are you doing to our friend!?
entries.uk: Ти що в біса робиш із нашою подругою?!

entries.speaker: Well-Dressed Man
entries.en: Sorry about the disturbance. It's just a...[n]lover's quarrel with my fiancée.
entries.uk: Перепрошую за клопіт. Це просто...[n]любовна сварка з моєю нареченою.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Fian— What? But she's clearly fighting[n]you!
entries.uk: Нарече— Що? Та вона ж явно[n]від вас відбивається!

entries.speaker: Fiancé
entries.en: ...How dare you make a fool of me? I'll be[n]telling your father about this, too!
entries.uk: ...Як ти смієш робити з мене дурня?[n]Я й твоєму батькові про це розповім!

entries.speaker: Fiancé
entries.en: ...I won't forget your faces.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you okay?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'm fine, but Mona-chan—
entries.uk: Зі мною все добре, але Мона-тян—

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: This is nothing...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Was that person really your fiancé?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Whoa, so you're engaged then!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That didn't seem like an ordinary fight[n]though...
entries.uk: Тільки це не було схоже на звичайну[n]сварку...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shouldn't you talk to your parents[n]about it?
entries.uk: Може, поговориш про це з батьками?

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: ...I think it'd be useless.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I'll just be told to beg for his forgiveness,[n]even if it means groveling on the ground...
entries.uk: Мені просто накажуть благати в нього[n]прощення, хай навіть на колінах...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: ...It seems she has her reasons.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I'll, um... apologize about what happened[n]earlier. So...
entries.uk: Я, е-е... перепрошую за те, що сталося[n]раніше. Тож...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Would you let Haru rest for a while?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Of course. We'll take her to your place,[n]yeah?
entries.uk: Авжеж. Відведемо її до вас, так?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...Thanks.
